nodes.name: Galvanostatic Pt Electrodeposition on Carbon Substrates
nodes.procedure: Pt nanoparticles were electrodeposited on the substrates by galvanostatic polarization from 5×10^{-3}M H₂PtCl₆ + 1M H₂SO₄ aqueous solution using single and multiple pulse galvanostatic polarization. The working electrode was prepared by spraying the homogeneous alcoholic suspension of carbon black or carbon nanotubes mixed with Nafion solution over the cleaned glassy carbon disc.

Further, the methanol oxidation reaction (MOR) was influenced by the deposit morphology.

nodes.source_text: Figure 3 shows the fabrication process of a composite of spherical MnO₂ coated with reduced graphene oxide by a facile and green step galvanostatic electrodeposition for oxygen reduction reaction (ORR).

The mesoporous Ni₀.₈Fe₀.₂ film synthesized here showed a significantly enhanced electrochemical active area of 25.3 mF cm⁻², a low overpotential of 206 mV at 10 mA cm⁻², and a small Tafel slope of 64 mV dec⁻¹. The newly developed process also led to excellent stability for a long time of up to 2×10⁵ s (more than 55 h) at 10 mA cm⁻²

A quartz boat loaded mesoporous Ni₃S₂ nanosheets/Ni foam exhibited a highly mesoporous structure with a specific surface area of 60.1 m² g⁻¹ and showed a low overpotential of 223 mV at a current density of 10 mA cm⁻² with a small Tafel slope of 60.5 mV dec⁻¹; this overpotential was superior to that of IrO₂/Ni foam. As-prepared Ni₃S₂ nanosheets/Ni foam achieved a high turnover frequency value of 0.61 mol O₂ s⁻¹ at an overpotential of 500 mV.

NiCoFe-PS nanorod/NF can reach 10 mA cm⁻² at the overpotential of 195 mV for OER... and 97.8 mV for HER. Besides, the as-obtained catalyst shows small Tafel slopes of 40.3 mV dec⁻¹ for OER and 51.8 mV dec⁻¹ for HER. The two-electrode cell using NiCoFe-PS nanorod/NF as both cathode and anode in the same electrolyte presents low potentials of 1.52 and 1.76 V to achieve 10 and 50 mA cm⁻², respectively, with excellent durability for 200 h
